description: Boolean logic on two gate signals, with eight results on their own outputs

params.text: Forces B high for as long as it is pressed, whatever the B input is doing

inputs.text: One of the two gate signals; it counts as high above 2V and low below 0.1V
One of the two gate signals; it counts as high above 2V and low below 0.1V

outputs.text: High when A is low, and low when A is high
High when B is low, and low when B is high
High when either A or B is high, or both
High when neither A nor B is high
High when A and B are both high
High unless A and B are both high
High when one of A and B is high but not the other
High when A and B are in the same state, both high or both low
